text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby. Her rival today, 
Admire Vega, paid no mind to Meisho Doto 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“I will dedicate my victories to my late 
sister.” Meisho Doto was thoroughly 
terrified by her strange, single-minded 
obsession...
